title: Dialect-specific SQL is regression-tested by compiling the production query with the target dialect
answers: how to test SQL generated for MSSQL without a real database
regression test for dialect-specific SQLAlchemy syntax
compile query with mssql dialect literal_binds in pytest
test MSSQL predicate compilation in label schema store tests
body:
To guard dialect-specific SQL, monkeypatch `sqlalchemy.orm.Query.first` in the test so it captures `query.statement.compile(dialect=mssql.dialect(), compile_kwargs={"literal_binds": True})` and returns None. This forces the production path (here, `_ensure_default_label_schema` falling through to INSERT) while recording the real SELECT.
Assert the compiled string contains the valid form (`is_default = 1`) and does not contain the invalid one (`is_default IS 1`).
Scope the monkeypatch with `monkeypatch.context()` so it does not leak into the rest of the test, then verify end state through the real store query (`store.list_label_schemas`).
Constraints: This checks compiled SQL only, not execution on a live MSSQL server. Use the same pattern for both standard and workspace-aware tracking store fixtures.
Applies: Tests in tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/ that need to verify SQL emitted for a non-default dialect.
applies: Pytest regression tests for SQLAlchemy store queries that must compile for MSSQL.
says: Loading default label schemas crashes when using a Microsoft SQL Server database.
Default question lookup fails on Microsoft SQL Server tracking store backends.
Label schema queries fail on SQL Server due to incompatible boolean syntax.
Ensure tracking store label schema queries remain compatible with SQL Server.
search: Dialect-specific SQL in SQLAlchemy store regression tests is verified without a live database by monkeypatching Query.first to compile the query statement with the target dialect. In tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_label_schemas.py:test_default_question_lookup_uses_mssql_compatible_boolean_predicate, monkeypatching Query.first with monkeypatch.context() forces _ensure_default_label_schema to record the compiled SELECT with mssql.dialect() and literal_binds=True, asserting is_default = 1 rather than is_default IS 1 before checking store.list_label_schemas. This pattern checks compiled SQL syntax only rather than live database execution, applying to tests in tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/ that verify queries emitted for non-default dialects across standard and workspace-aware fixtures.
